correctness.rationale: Exact EGF of square-admitting permutations follows from necessary-and-sufficient even-cycle parity. Odd factor has n^-1/2 coefficient asymptotic; even cosh tail has finite alpha moment for 1/2<alpha<1; coefficient convolution delivers independent short-cycle limits. Effective bounded-degree Hanf locality yields upper set inclusion; definability of disjoint short cycles yields converse. Finite event probabilities lie in Q(e^{1/D}); independent odd Poisson indicators give density. Checker exhaustively tested 16517 admissible labelled examples through n=8 and rational coefficients; finite data not invoked to establish infinite claims.
